% and past participle, with a sound only where the stressed vowel is an e or
% an o the spelling does not mark; every noun carries its gender.  The
% pronunciation line is given only where it shows what the spelling does

% of more than one syllable marked.  What the fixture protects is the
% spelling: the accents, the apostrophe of d'hora and the hyphen of
% compartir-lo must come back out of the pipeline exactly as they went in.
